projects.name: OneIdP — Zero Trust Access

Just-in-Time Admin with temporary privilege elevation & audit logs
LAPS — Local Admin Password Solution with automated rotation

linkedin.name: OneID

Remote Terminal & Device Mirroring for troubleshooting

linkedin.name: UEM Software | Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) Solution

linkedin.name: Veltar Endpoint Security | Empowering Security, Enabling Innovation
